name: template_embed_counts
source_sql: SELECT t.id, t.categ_id, t.uom_id, t.type, t.list_price, t.active, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_template_attribute_line l WHERE l.product_tmpl_id = t.id) AS attribute_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_optional_rel o WHERE o.dest_id = t.id) AS optional_products, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_template_uom_uom_rel u WHERE u.product_template_id = t.id) AS extra_uoms FROM product_template t

name: variant_embed_counts
source_sql: SELECT p.id, p.product_tmpl_id, p.default_code, p.active, p.lst_price, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_variant_combination c WHERE c.product_product_id = p.id) AS combination_values, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_uom u WHERE u.product_id = p.id) AS packagings, (SELECT count(*) FROM customer_product_reference r WHERE r.product_id = p.id) AS customer_references, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_product_uom_uom_rel x WHERE x.product_product_id = p.id) AS extra_uoms FROM product_product p

name: variant_combination_pairs
source_sql: SELECT c.product_product_id, c.product_template_attribute_value_id FROM product_variant_combination c

name: ptav_relation_counts
source_sql: SELECT v.id, v.product_tmpl_id, v.attribute_id, v.product_attribute_value_id, v.price_extra, v.ptav_active, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_template_attribute_excluded_value_ids_rel e WHERE e.excluded_product_template_attribute_value_id = v.id) AS excluded_values, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_template_attribute_value_sale_order_line_rel s WHERE s.product_template_attribute_value_id = v.id) AS sale_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_template_attribute_value_purchase_order_line_rel pu WHERE pu.product_template_attribute_value_id = v.id) AS purchase_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM template_attribute_value_stock_move_rel m WHERE m.template_attribute_value_id = v.id) AS stock_moves FROM product_template_attribute_value v

name: attribute_line_value_counts
source_sql: SELECT product_template_attribute_line_id, count(*) AS n, min(product_attribute_value_id) AS min_value_id, max(product_attribute_value_id) AS max_value_id FROM product_attribute_value_product_template_attribute_line_rel GROUP BY product_template_attribute_line_id

name: combo_item_lines
source_sql: SELECT i.combo_id, i.id AS item_id, i.product_id, i.extra_price, c.sequence AS combo_sequence FROM product_combo_item i JOIN product_combo c ON c.id = i.combo_id

name: combo_templates
source_sql: SELECT r.product_combo_id, r.product_template_id FROM product_combo_product_template_rel r

name: vendor_lines_per_partner
source_sql: SELECT partner_id, count(*) AS lines, min(price) AS min_price, max(price) AS max_price, sum(min_qty) AS total_min_qty, max(delay) AS max_delay FROM product_supplierinfo GROUP BY partner_id

name: pricelists_with_rule_counts
source_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name->>'en_US' AS name, p.active, p.sequence, p.company_id, p.currency_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_pricelist_item i WHERE i.pricelist_id = p.id) AS rules FROM product_pricelist p

name: pricelist_rules_detail
source_sql: SELECT i.id, i.pricelist_id, i.applied_on, i.base, i.compute_price, i.min_quantity, i.fixed_price, i.price_discount, i.price_surcharge, i.product_tmpl_id, i.product_id, i.categ_id, i.company_id, i.currency_id FROM product_pricelist_item i
